title: No state root or runtime path is created while coverage is missing
statement: With the Kiln ignore block absent, edited, partial or negated, deciding project-local state refuses and creates nothing: the state root and every runtime path it would hold do not exist after the refusal, which is what is asserted rather than that a warning was produced. The refusal carries the three choices as data - append the exact ignore block, with the bytes it would add; external state; stop - each marked available or not, and a block that is present but edited marks the append choice unavailable rather than silently composing new bytes over it.
notes: ⚠️ NARROWED TO WHAT TSK-0031 BUILDS. The criterion asked for interactive setup to OFFER the three choices and for non-interactive setup to REFUSE. There is no setup command yet, so nothing could render them and nothing could be non-interactive about them; what this library produces is the refusal and the choices as data. The integration moved to the criterion on TSK-0060 that owns the setup command. ⚠️ THE ASSERTION IS ABSENCE, NOT A MESSAGE. A warning printed before a directory is created is exactly the failure REQ-0027 names, so the check is that the paths are not there.
